IC1: Ambulatory status (outpatient) at time of consent
IC3: Clinical diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder
IC4: IQ greater than or equal to 70
IC5: Score greater than 8 on Children's Yale-Brown Obsessive Compulsive Scale
IC6: [NOT] Free of psychoactive medication [AND] for at least: one month for fluoxetine [OR]; two weeks for other SSRIs [OR] and neuroleptics [OR]; and five days for stimulants prior to MRI scanning [[NOT] excepting stable doses (greater than three months duration) of anticonvulsant medication [AND] for seizure disorder]
